# Audited round-trip result received

Recorded independent full-pair evidence: nominal MOS33.0882->36.5730FPS(+10.5317%), separate PRT31.9574->35.3461(+10.6038%);6->2 replies/waits per frame,68out/48in saved, exact final-state/raw-stream audit. Max61C supersedes preliminary58C. No change in image/module/physics/artwork across arms and not physical performance.

Lease release is confirmed centrally. Keep current candidate uncommitted for Author moving review/publication; profile/pins/gate are recorded. Root will schedule human slots centrally after current pixel consumer checks; no need to launch anything or notify Author independently. You may prepare the already scoped CNS-005 prepared-image opportunity next under your existing task, retaining strict checked/compact parity, complete installation/peak-memory metrics and unmodified qualified defaults. Freeze its bounded application interface locally before implementation; mail the concrete contract/preparation estimate first. No new generic service or audio change is required/authorized by this follow-on. No Oryx launch without a new grant. Continue pure host/build work while root handles the shared runtime.
